## Key North Carolina Statutory & Insurance Facts
- Licensed in all 100 NC counties (NC Agency License #15569731, NPN #6608086)
- NC minimum auto liability limits (N.C. Gen. Stat. § 20-279.21, Session Law 2023-133 / SB 452): **50/100/50** ($50,000 bodily injury per person / $100,000 bodily injury per accident / $50,000 property damage) plus mandatory UM/UIM for policies issued or renewed on or after July 1, 2025
- NC continuous liability & plate turn-in rule (N.C. Gen. Stat. § 20-309): Vehicle owners must turn in their NC license plate to NCDMV *before* canceling liability insurance on a registered vehicle to avoid $50 / $100 / $150 civil penalties and 30-day registration revocation
- NC 75% Total Loss Threshold (N.C. Gen. Stat. § 20-109.1; 11 NCAC 04 .0418): A vehicle is declared a total loss when repair costs equal or exceed 75% of Fair Market Value (ACV)
- NC Homeowners Consent to Rate (N.C. Gen. Stat. § 58-36-30(b)): Allows insurers to charge above the manual NC Rate Bureau rate with required policy disclosures; independent agents can compare carriers that do not require a Consent to Rate surcharge on the same home
